title: The Loss Floor of Denoising Score Matching: Fisher Geometry from Schr\"odinger Bridges
abstract: arXiv:2608.23916v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Denoising score matching trains diffusion models by regressing onto a conditional score, although generation ultimately requires the marginal score. The two objectives share the same population minimizer, but the conditional target remains random at fixed noisy state and introduces an irreducible excess in the training loss. We isolate this excess and show that, for a general corruption kernel under mild regularity assumptions, it is exactly the trace of the Fisher--Rao metric of the conditional endpoint family, integrated along the diffusion trajectory. This gives an exact conditional-variance decomposition of the denoising objective and identifies the information geometry observed in diffusion latent spaces as an intrinsic component of the training loss. translated_title: 去噪评分匹配的损失下限：来自薛定谔桥的费舍尔几何
translated_abstract: 去噪评分匹配通过回归到条件评分来训练扩散模型，尽管生成最终需要边际评分。这两个目标共享相同的总体最小化器，但条件目标在固定噪声状态下保持随机性，并引入训练损失中不可约的额外部分。我们隔离了这种额外部分，并表明，在温和正则性假设下，对于一般损坏核，它恰好是条件端点族的费舍尔-拉奥度量的迹，沿扩散轨迹积分。这给出了去噪目标的精确条件方差分解，并将扩散潜空间中观察到的信息几何识别为训练损失的内在组成部分。我们从薛定谔桥变分原理推导出该结果，其中理想目标作为路径空间相对熵的额外部分出现。对于损坏扩散，费舍尔度量...
tldr: 本文通过薛定谔桥原理，证明了去噪评分匹配的训练损失下限等价于条件端点族费舍尔-拉奥度量的迹，揭示了扩散潜空间的信息几何是训练损失的内在部分。
en_tdlr: This paper proves via Schr\"odinger bridge principle that the loss floor of denoising score matching equals the trace of the Fisher-Rao metric of conditional endpoint family, identifying information geometry in diffusion latent spaces as intrinsic to training loss.
